# AI Operations Center — full brief

> Free CEO/COO weekly operating brief builder by Tomas Staniulis (Prompt Anatomy). Optional Operations cadence and board-ready Strategy playbooks from $9.99.

## Product

AI Operations Center is a free CEO/COO weekly operating brief builder at https://www.promptanatomy.ceo/en/. Paste KPIs, runway, and context; copy a structured prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. No account required.

## How the free tool works

- Modes: Strategic, Daily, Weekly.
- Depths: Fast (short prioritized answer), Deep (analysis and rationale), Board (executive summary with risks and actions).
- Output is a copy-ready operating brief prompt for the executive to review before acting.

## Paid PDF playbooks

- CEO AI Operations Playbook: 21 pages, $9.99. Run a practical CEO/COO AI operating cadence in one week: daily priorities, weekly decisions, owner/deadline discipline, fact-based reflection, and CEO quick picks for 2-minute decisions.
- CEO AI Strategy Playbook: 43 pages, $19.99. Turn AI from random prompting into a board-ready executive decision system: strategy prompts, finance checks, risk review, ownership gates, 30/90-day implementation, and strategic shortcuts for 2-minute decisions.

## Problems we solve

Built for US CEOs and COOs who need operating cadence and board-ready decisions—not generic prompt tips:

- Unclear ROI from AI spend — Executives cannot tie AI use to cash, runway, or measurable decisions.
- Random prompting without cadence — Ad-hoc ChatGPT use with no repeatable weekly operating rhythm.
- Tool overload — Too many AI tools and frameworks; no single executive workflow.
- Weak ownership inside the company — No clear who owns AI outputs, review, or governance-lite guardrails.
- Low-quality executive outputs — Generic AI answers that are not decision-ready for CEO/COO review.
- Fragmented knowledge — Prompts and rituals live in scattered docs, not one playbook.
- Poor decision and board support — Missing board-ready framing, risk view, and Type 1/Type 2 decision structure.
- Lack of repeatable workflows — No fixed daily/weekly steps the leadership team can run every week.

## Privacy model

Saved sessions are stored locally in the browser (localStorage). The page does not upload form inputs to a server for prompt generation.

## Responsible use

This tool generates prompts and training material. Review AI outputs before using them for executive decisions.
